name: Arena Powerfin Pro open-heel training fins
description: The open-heel pocket is the comfort winner for big yardage — no heel blisters, and easy on and off with cold, pruny hands. The short, stiff blade still delivers real propulsion without slowing your tempo.

name: Speedo Team Pull Buoy
description: The bulk-bin workhorse — cheap, durable, and perfectly functional. It survives being thrown in a bag, stepped on, and left in a hot car all summer, which is why clubs buy it by the dozen.

name: FINIS team swim cap in silicone or latex
description: The smart buy for a team, a family, or anyone who loses caps constantly. Team packs in silicone or cheaper latex cover the basics without the per-cap premium.

name: Speedo Tech Paddle
description: The versatile everyday choice — a mid-size rectangular paddle with adjustable finger and wrist tubing. Big enough to build real strength, small enough not to instantly wreck your shoulders, and adjustable enough to grow with you.
